add.event: 第纳里乌斯问世，此后成色与重量缓慢持续下降
add.evidence: Although the denarius remained the backbone of the Roman economy from its introduction a few years before 211 BC until it ceased to be normally minted in the middle of the third century, the purity and weight of the coin slowly, but inexorably, decreased.
